name: NJ / NYC / Philly Tri-State
desc: By far the largest 2024–25 cluster. The Dec 2024–Jan 2025 "New Jersey drone" flap. Dense population + media virality + proximity to NYC airspace, military/naval installations (Picatinny Arsenal, Naval Weapons Station Earle, McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst) and major flight corridors into JFK/EWR/LGA/PHL.

name: United Kingdom
desc: Dense population, extensive CCTV/doorbell-cam culture, busy military and civil airspace (RAF bases, NATO exercises), and a media environment primed by the NJ drone story. London, Scotland, regional England all flagged.

name: California (LA / Bay Area / San Diego / Joshua Tree)
desc: Huge population base, dark-sky desert areas (Joshua Tree, Mojave) near military test ranges (Edwards AFB, China Lake), heavy air traffic, and a long cultural history of UAP interest. The Tic Tac encounter occurred off San Diego in this region.

name: Florida (Jacksonville / Tampa / Miami / Orlando)
desc: Proximity to Cape Canaveral / KSC rocket launches, busy coastal flight paths, and a high density of outdoor activity. Jacksonville and Tampa feature repeatedly.

name: Arizona (Phoenix / Tucson / Scottsdale)
desc: Clear desert skies, Luke AFB and Davis-Monthan AFB military flight testing. The Phoenix metro's history with the 1997 Phoenix Lights keeps residents primed to watch and report.

name: Louisiana (Lake Charles / Baton Rouge / Monroe)
desc: Proximity to Barksdale AFB and Fort Polk, plus offshore oil/gas helicopter and drone traffic over the Gulf. Barksdale is a nuclear bomber wing facility.

name: Ireland (County Meath / Kerry / Kildare)
desc: A recurring cluster in County Meath (multiple reports), plus general spillover from the UK drone-wave. County Meath reports are particularly concentrated.

name: Scotland (Aberdeenshire / Edinburgh)
desc: RAF Lossiemouth and North Sea oil/gas helicopter corridors. Edinburgh and Aberdeenshire feature in the Dec 2024 wave.
